snippet.title: Packed Lair - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WHAT IF BASE BUILDING MET TETRIS? PACKED LAIR LAUNCHES ON STEAM SEPTEMBER 22!

Wishlist The Game on Steam Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489680/Packed_Lair/ 

In Packed Lair, players take on the role of an evil lord with a serious problem: heroes keep invading their lair. Unfortunately, there’s also a second problem - the lair is really, really cramped.

Pack your evil lair, build a monster army, and repel wave after wave of invading heroes in this chaotic fusion of inventory management, base building, and auto-battler strategy. 

Across each run, players can unlock new buildings, discover new combinations, expand their lair, and experiment with different ways to turn a cramped underground hideout into a highly efficient monster-making machine.
